purpose.text: Automated workflow to verify endpoint connectivity, inspect registry for IFEO Debugger blocks, remove the block, and refresh policy.
purpose.quote: Automated workflow to verify endpoint connectivity, inspect registry for IFEO Debugger blocks, remov

scope.text: Applies to software operations and authorized agents.
scope.quote: Applies to software operations and authorized agents.

steps.action: Verify endpoint network connectivity before performing remote diagnostics.
steps.expected_outcome: If ping replies are received, set variables.endpoint_reachable = true, else set variables.endpoint_reachable = false
steps.quote: Verify endpoint network connectivity before performing remote diagnostics.

steps.action: Query IFEO registry key to check if application is blocked by a Debugger entry.
steps.input: reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\{{entities.application}}.exe"
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'Debugger', set variables.ifeo_blocked = true, else set variables.ifeo_blocked = false
steps.quote: Query IFEO registry key to check if application is blocked by a Debugger entry.

steps.action: Remove IFEO Debugger registry value or full key to unblock execution.
steps.input: reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\{{entities.application}}.exe" /v Debugger /f
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.block_removed = true, else set variables.block_removed = false
steps.warning: reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\{{entities.application}}.exe" /f
steps.quote: Remove IFEO Debugger registry value or full key to unblock execution.

steps.action: Refresh local Group Policy to apply unblock changes immediately.
steps.quote: Refresh local Group Policy to apply unblock changes immediately.

steps.action: Verify IFEO block removal by re-querying the target registry key.
steps.input: reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\{{entities.application}}.exe"
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'Debugger', set variables.block_verified = false, else set variables.block_verified = true
steps.quote: Verify IFEO block removal by re-querying the target registry key.
